summary: The escaped SQLITE_BUSY occurrences on record through 2026-09-30 are application defects, not storage-engine limits. No write transaction spans a subprocess, network call or large filesystem operation. Ten-process conformance retains exact effects and zero escaped busy without retired ownership operations. CD-0011's reopen conditions remain for later escapes, with the single-writer comparison first.
title: The escaped SQLITE_BUSY on record is an application defect, not a storage limit
